scripts.pages:dev: npm run build:frontend-dist && npx wrangler pages dev ./ --kv "img_url" --r2 "img_r2" --ip 0.0.0.0 --port 8080 --persist-to ./data
scripts.build:worker: npm run build:frontend-dist && npm run generate:worker-routes && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir .wrangler-worker-build
scripts.worker:dev: npm run build:frontend-dist && npm run generate:worker-routes && wrangler dev --port 8788 --persist-to ./data
scripts.worker:deploy: npm run build:frontend-dist && npm run generate:worker-routes && wrangler deploy
scripts.worker:deploy:dev: npm run build:frontend-dist && npm run generate:worker-routes && wrangler deploy --env dev
